findings.evidenceJa: 長い年月をかけて磨耗しきった空間
findings.governingReading: The basement is a whole space exhausted by attrition across a long span of years.
findings.explanation: A space worn away over long years becomes merely everything being worn out.

findings.evidenceJa: ある血脈の執念の果て
findings.governingReading: The darkness is the grave marker produced at the end of a certain lineage's obsession.
findings.explanation: One bloodline's obsession becomes multiple vindictive bloodlines.

findings.highlight: It appears all seven have been selected.
findings.governingReading: The underground speaker observes that the complete set of seven has apparently come together.
findings.explanation: All seven being assembled becomes all seven being selected.

findings.highlight: leaving its flesh and bones intact, but taking it over
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体の外見は手付かずのまま、その中身という中身を“蟲”にとって代わられる
findings.governingReading: An ordinary victim would retain its outward appearance while its contents were comprehensively replaced by worms.
findings.explanation: Preserved outward appearance becomes preserved flesh and bones. This changes the hypothetical victim from a body whose contents are replaced into one whose tissues partly remain.

findings.highlight: The massive insects that live in the basement
findings.evidenceJa: この、夥しいまでに地下室に生息する蟲
findings.governingReading: The reversal identifies the tremendous multitude living in the basement as food for the humanoid thing.
findings.explanation: An enormous number of basement worms becomes individually massive insects.

findings.governingReading: It says there is still a future ahead and that this occasion is not necessarily the last.
findings.explanation: The speaker having future opportunities becomes not having enough time.

findings.highlight: It twists its mouth in disapproval.
findings.evidenceJa: さて、とソレは口元を歪める
findings.governingReading: The hidden figure twists its mouth before assessing the current conditions; the exact emotion is unstated.
findings.explanation: A twisted mouth is assigned disapproval.

findings.highlight: The battle is about to start once again, less than ten years after the last.
findings.evidenceJa: 前回の戦いから十年足らずで開こうとする孔
findings.governingReading: The defective ritual field is characterized by its gate-like hole opening prematurely after the last conflict.
findings.explanation: A hole or aperture trying to open less than ten years after the previous War becomes the battle itself starting again.

findings.highlight: A complete Grail simply will not be forged from such an unstable battle.
findings.evidenceJa: このような不安定な戦いで満ちる杯など完全には程遠い
findings.governingReading: The cup filled by this unstable conflict will remain far from complete.
findings.explanation: An unstable battle failing to fill a complete Grail becomes failing to forge one.

findings.highlight: For ten years, fragments of the Holy Grail have spread into and throughout their nerves.
findings.evidenceJa: 十年間、神経の至るところまで聖杯の欠片に侵食された細胞具である
findings.governingReading: The prepared entity is called a cellular implement, with Grail fragments having invaded its nerves over ten years.
findings.explanation: The English drops the specific description of the prepared being as a cellular implement. Its treatment as a manufactured, disposable thing remains clear nearby.

findings.highlight: It is only natural for things originating from the same source be attracted to one another.
findings.evidenceJa: 元が同じモノ同士、引き合うのは当然だろう
findings.governingReading: Things of the same origin naturally attract one another.
findings.explanation: The sentence 'for things originating from the same source be attracted' omits 'to.'

findings.highlight: I may have I received it as a placental vessel initially
findings.evidenceJa: 胎盤として貰いうけたものだが
findings.governingReading: The speaker says it originally received the being as a placenta.
findings.explanation: The clause 'I may have I received it' duplicates the subject and breaks the verb phrase.

findings.highlight: now it has perfectly adapted to its purpose
findings.evidenceJa: ほぼ完全と言えるまで適合している
findings.governingReading: The experimental subject has achieved a degree of compatibility that can be called almost complete.
findings.explanation: Near-complete compatibility becomes perfect adaptation to a purpose.

findings.highlight: Well, that is why I wanted a vessel that possesses strong Magic Circuits.
findings.evidenceJa: まあ、優れた魔術回路を持つ胎盤を望んだのだ
findings.governingReading: The speaker concedes that because it wanted a placenta with excellent Magic Circuits, resistance to ego-corroding poison follows logically as an unwanted consequence.
findings.explanation: Strong mental defenses are made the reason the speaker wanted strong Magic Circuits.

findings.highlight: It has erected quite the fortress to defend itself
findings.evidenceJa: この世で最も堅固な要塞だ
findings.governingReading: Though lacking a blade for counterattack, its psyche is itself an exceptionally solid fortress.
findings.explanation: The subject itself being the world's strongest fortress becomes having erected a fortress.

findings.highlight: Its futile emotions should be the key to transforming it.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身の昏い感情こそが、アレを変貌させる鍵
findings.governingReading: The speaker identifies the subject's own dark or shadowed feelings as the key that can transform it from within.

findings.highlight: That is the ethos writhing within this basement.
findings.evidenceJa: それがこの地下室に渦巻く執念だ
findings.governingReading: Killing every Master and seizing every Servant is the violent fixation permeating the cellar, not a neutral code of principles.
findings.explanation: The basement's swirling obsession becomes its ethos.

findings.highlight: It emits a sigh of relief, and the mood softens.
findings.evidenceJa: 安堵の声と、弛緩する空気
findings.governingReading: After the manipulator outwardly agrees to observe, a relieved voice and slackening atmosphere come from the visiting interlocutor; the manipulator then smiles gently to reinforce the deception.
findings.explanation: The visitor's relief is assigned to the manipulator.

findings.highlight: Faint disappointment flickers like an ember in the basement.
findings.evidenceJa: 見逃してしまうほどの小さな負の感情が地下室に灯る
findings.governingReading: The Tohsaka comparison kindles a negative feeling so slight the visitor does not notice it. The Japanese does not identify that feeling as disappointment.
findings.explanation: An unspecified small negative emotion becomes disappointment.
